text: Very good ideal and mostly good execution. I miss only one thing. There is no loging of data. The only information i get about keeping up my habits and tasks is how god i am doing in the game. It is fun and helps me keep up and even motivates sometimes, but i would like a long term raw data or graph about when was i better or worst to see progress. Update: the link provided by the dev shows the data i was missing.

developer_reply: Péter, thanks for your review! We’re actually working on graphs and stats right now and hope to add them very soon! In the meantime, you may find the Data Display Tool helpful: https://tools.habitica.com/
